title: Sam Power Music Ceremony: ' A Journey To The Heart'
short_description: Take time out from your daily routine to come and relax deeply inward, to journey delicately back to your own essence of rest, peace and love.
description: Through Sam's original ' Songs from the Soul' you will be sensitively guided on the ' Journey To The Heart'. Its a space for you to deeply just 'be'. To receive what you need to receive through the sacred transmissions. Each song carries a different 'soul theme' and with it a unique message of remembering for you to connect with.
